name: Byte Glossary
description:
Byte Glossary — fast, complete explainers for tech and computer science.

Each video maps one topic from zero: every key term defined, connected, and explained in 12–22 minutes. No fluff, no prerequisites, no 40-tab rabbit holes.

Whether you're prepping for an interview, filling a knowledge gap, or just curious how things work — one video is the whole picture.

New explainers weekly.

Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@ByteGlossary
audience: students, self-taught developers, and curious adults who want fast concept maps
